name: ggshield
description: Scan for hardcoded secrets using ggshield. Credentials are read from a Generic service connection.
author: GitGuardian

inputs.name: gitguardianConnection
inputs.label: GitGuardian service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Generic service connection that stores the ggshield API key (Password field) and, optionally, the GitGuardian dashboard URL (Server URL field, e.g. `https://dashboard.gitguardian.com` for SaaS US, `https://dashboard.eu1.gitguardian.com` for SaaS EU, or your self-hosted dashboard URL). ggshield derives the API URL from the dashboard URL.

inputs.name: scanMode
inputs.label: Scan mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: Which ggshield secret scan subcommand to run.

inputs.name: scanTarget
inputs.label: Scan target
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path or image to scan. Only used when scanMode is 'path' or 'docker'. Ignored for 'ci'.

inputs.name: failOnIssues
inputs.label: Fail the build when secrets are found

inputs.name: scanTimeoutSeconds
inputs.label: Scan timeout (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum wall-clock time allowed for the ggshield scan. When exceeded, the scan is terminated and the step completes as SucceededWithIssues (a warning, not a failure) — this prevents GitGuardian API rate-limit events from turning into org-wide pipeline outages via ggshield's unbounded retry-on-429 behavior.
